description: Get the current BrewPage limits (GET /api/limits): request size; per type (html, json, kv, files, sites) max size, counts and TTL default/maximum; profileMaxTtlDays (TTL cap for a token in a profile); site ZIP expansion, path and name lengths, allowed file extensions and skipped system files. Sizes are bytes, TTLs days. The answer always has reach: `profile` only when the owner token is active in a profile, else `token` (also with no token). With a usable owner token also ownerMaxTtlDays.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: get_limits
title: Get upload limits
